attributes.board_name: Virginia Board of Physical Therapy (Department of Health Professions)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 contact hours in Type 1 courses (directly related to clinical PT practice, approved or provided by a Board-approved organization; 1 college credit hour = 15 contact hours). Max 10 hours Type 2 (consultation with colleagues, independent study, research/writing, teaching, clinical supervision of students at 40 h = 1 hour, up to 2 h volunteer PT at a free clinic/health department, up to 2 h attending a Board meeting or disciplinary proceeding). APTA specialty certification/recertification or graduating from a transitional DPT program satisfies the biennium.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the first biennial renewal after initial licensure by examination in Virginia.
rules.audit_note: Keep the Board's Continued Competency Activity and Assessment Form with supporting documents for 4 years; random audit, documents due within 30 days. CE Broker is an optional tracking system since Oct 1, 2024.
rules.notes: Renewal by December 31 of each even-numbered year. Active renewal also requires 320 hours of active practice in the preceding four years. No mandatory topics; licensees should consider ethics, standard of care, patient safety, new technology, communication and the changing health care system.
rules.rule_quote: A. In order to renew an active license biennially, a physical therapist or a physical therapist assistant shall complete at least 30 contact hours of continuing learning activities within the two years immediately preceding renewal.
